Saturday Night Live

Comedy· 51 Seasons· TV Series· 1975·TV-14

NBC’s Emmy Award-winning late-night comedy showcase “Saturday Night Live” returns in fall 2025 for its 51st season of laughs, surprises and standout performances.

“SNL” is the most Emmy-winning show in history and holds 113 Emmy wins (including awards for its specials and short form series). “SNL” has been honored four times with the prestigious George Foster Peabody Award and was inducted into the Broadcasting Hall of Fame. The show continues to garner the highest ratings and largest audience of any late-night television program, entertaining millions each week on linear and digital platforms.

Since its inception in 1975, “SNL” has launched the careers of many of the brightest comedy performers of their generation. “SNL” makes headlines with topical humor reflecting politics and current events, features an array of characters with a perspective on pop culture that remains unparalleled, and offers sharp political commentary through its signature “Weekend Update” segment. A variety show that is truly one of a kind, “SNL” also attracts the biggest stars of music to its stage for innovative viral performances.

Peacock is the streaming home of your favorite NBC shows plus so much more.
Starring: Tommy Brennan, Michael Che, Jeremy Culhane, Mikey Day, Andrew Dismukes, Chloe Fineman, Marcello Hernández, James Austin Johnson, Colin Jost, Ben Marshall, Ashley Padilla, Kam Patterson, Sarah Sherman, Veronika Slowikowska, Kenan Thompson, Jane Wickline, and Bowen Yang
Executive Producer: Lorne Michaels

Saturday Night Live FAQs

Where can I watch Saturday Night Live?
You can watch Saturday Night Live (SNL) on Peacock. Just sign up for a Peacock account and start streaming. View the full list of supported streaming devices.

Watch new episodes from Season 51 of SNL live on NBC and Peacock on Saturdays at 11:30/10:30c.
How many seasons of Saturday Night Live are there?
There are currently 51 seasons of Saturday Night Live (SNL), all available to stream on Peacock. New episodes air Saturdays at 11:30/10:30c on NBC and Peacock.
When did the new season of Saturday Night Live start?
SNL Season 51 premiered on NBC and Peacock Saturday, October 4, 2025.
Which cast members are not returning to SNL for Season 51?
Devon Walker, Michael Longfellow, Emil Wakim, and Heidi Gardner are not returning to SNL Season 51.
Can I watch SNL live on Peacock?
Yes, you can watch SNL live on Peacock every Saturday night at 11:30/10:30c!
